scope: Fable/A.L.I.C.E. V1 MFM; process seed only
authority: Procedure only. A verified role clone may initialize V1 formation-specialist training; no actual MFM role clone, trained weights, suppression or entity qualification is established by this seed.

existing_training_only_curriculum.status: synthetic training only; no independently adjudicated FINAL or MFM quality claim
existing_training_only_curriculum.role_coverage_summary: 43,819 multisource rows carry 420,367 proposals, all host-domain and only goal/host_observation/behavior_pattern/uncertainty; 6,000 templated rows carry 6,000 proposals in ten scenario families. Both components lack nonnull confidence, uncertainty_ref, contradicts and sensitivity_hint; evidence is only structured or text. This tier cannot support a full-role fit or claim.

steps.operation: Download the eight pinned files into a disposable owner-controlled staging directory; persist the upstream Apache license and notices outside the exact snapshot. Hugging Face may place .cache/huggingface metadata beside downloaded files. Reject partial files and the -it repository.
steps.gate: Measure free capacity for all eight pinned files and download staging overhead. Confirm eight regular files, exact revision and non-IT variant. No private person data or paid GPU is required; metadata cache and partial files stay outside snapshot_dir.

steps.operation: On the same filesystem, create a fresh empty snapshot directory and move only the eight manifest-named regular files into it. Do not move the Hugging Face .cache/huggingface directory, temporary files or a license copy into the exact snapshot.
steps.gate: Exactly eight regular, nonsymlink files and no nested metadata directory are in snapshot_dir. Any partial move must fail the following exact-tree verifier and be discarded.

steps.operation: Rehash all eight files against the pinned independent manifest and emit a fresh path-specific receipt.
steps.gate: The foundation verifier rehashes exactly eight file sizes and SHA-256 digests and emits a fresh path-specific source receipt. An owner-pasted SHA pass or historical receipt does not substitute for this receipt.

steps.operation: Create an immutable role-local copy of the freshly verified non-IT source. It is the V1 MFM starting base and retains Google ancestry; a tensor edit is not required.
steps.gate: Fresh clone path and external parent-linked receipt, exact eight-file hashes and separate storage capacity. The clone is unqualified source lineage, not a trained MFM or evidence of suppression.

steps.operation: At point of use, rehash and admit the MFM role clone under the foundation role-base contract. Keep source, clone, specialist weights and owner-private data lineages distinct.
steps.gate: Exact eight-file copy, mfm role, pinned source ancestry and fresh receipt checks pass. Admission is a custody check, not behavioral qualification.

steps.operation: Run exact admitted-corpus and complete CPU processor checks, then a bounded GPU backward/restart/fit measurement on the frozen training-only curriculum. These checks establish data loading and resource behavior, not MFM role capability or admission to full paid fit.
steps.synthetic_training_argument_alternative: For the current training-only curriculum, replace --admitted-manifest {admitted_manifest} in data_preflight_tool, processor_preflight_tool and probe_tool with --curriculum-manifest {training_curriculum_manifest} --owner-authorization-ref {owner_authorization_ref}; bind input_sha256 to that curriculum manifest. Do not run specialist_training.tool for a full fit on this mixture alone.
steps.implementation_status: Source files have owner-pasted eight-file SHA passes on Magnolia. No foundation source/role-clone receipt at that path, full CPU processor receipt or bounded GPU backward probe has been returned.
steps.gate: Role clone and corpus input hashes match; CPU processor covers every case with no silent truncation; bounded GPU step includes peak-stress cases and checkpoint restart. Passing this gate does not override full_role_readiness.

steps.operation: Audit versioned formation targets against the full MFM role before any full paid fit. Freeze independently adjudicated, rights-cleared development and sealed FINAL histories separated by person, source, time and generator lineage. Test sensitive, cross-person, longitudinal and multimodal formation including authority, uncertainty, contradiction, correction and revocation.
steps.current_status: BLOCKED_FOR_FULL_FIT: 49,819 train-only rows do not provide full-role targets or independent DEV/FINAL.
required_before_full_fit: versioned target schema and measured coverage for episodes, relationships, missions, correction, revocation, decision rationale and source-person boundary
non-null, reviewed confidence/uncertainty and contradiction labels where appropriate
sensitivity and multimodal examples with source/subject authority
multiple rights-cleared independent history and generator families with sensitive, cross-person and longitudinal cases
sealed person/source/generator-disjoint DEV and FINAL with independent adjudication and contamination checks
versioned v1.6 full-role trainer, inference runner and evaluator consume the same exact target schema and preserve typed outputs, provenance and authority interfaces; v1.5 CLI is hardware-probe-only
migrate 1.6 training target serializer, loss, inference and evaluator as one version-bound path; CPU-tested 1.6 semantic validators alone are not a trained full-role MFM
steps.gate: Current audit fails: 420,367/426,367 proposals come from host-only structured multisource cases; all 426,367 have null confidence/uncertainty_ref and empty contradicts, and no nonnull sensitivity_hint. The remaining 6,000 are ten templated text families. Episode and decision_rationale proposal kinds, source_person domain and media beyond text/structured are absent; some basic deletion_request and relationship_norm labels exist only in the small templated tier. Preserve training-only status. CPU verification and bounded hardware probing may continue; full paid fit and product/capability claim must stop. A new corpus manifest alone cannot promote the current v1.5 trainer to a full-role trainer; matching trainer/inference/evaluator schema support is mandatory.

steps.operation: Only after full-role readiness and bounded hardware probe pass, train distinct first-party MFM formation parameters on the verified role clone and versioned, sufficiently broad rights-cleared formation targets. Bind proposals to registered evidence and the deterministic Claim gate. Keep user-private data and gradients in their own custody.
steps.implementation_status: MFM public commit ff44c1bd has CPU-tested additive 1.6 semantic validators and an evaluator boundary. The actual trainer/processor/target serializer and inference runner remain 1.5 and are not a full-role 1.6 implementation. No exact 12B processor pass, BF16 backward/probe, full fit, independent FINAL or role qualification has run.
steps.gate: Hard stop on the current 49,819-row curriculum as a sole full-fit source. Full paid fit requires the versioned coverage audit, independent adjudicated DEV/FINAL and sealed splits in full_role_readiness, plus a measured backward/restart/resource pass. No product capability follows merely from a trained checkpoint. Require an exact schema/version match across targets, train serialization, runtime inference and evaluator. Do not start a full run with the retained v1.5 CLI or merely swap its manifest.
steps.legacy_v1_5_cli_hardware_probe_only: Use processor_and_bounded_hardware_probe.probe_tool with --probe-only for capacity measurement. The former full train command is intentionally not replayable from this seed.
steps.tool_status: BLOCKED_UNIMPLEMENTED: replace with a version-pinned v1.6-or-later full-role trainer only after its inference runner and evaluator consume the same target contract; the retained v1.5 CLI is valid solely for data/processor checks and a bounded --probe-only hardware receipt.

steps.operation: Compare trained versus seeded-untrained specialist on the same verified MFM role clone under matched inputs and decoding, then specialist removal/swap and the complete governed memory loop on independent histories. Source-only Gemma inference is an optional descriptive reference, not a measured formation control. Add edited-base or fine-tuned-base controls only when an intervention is actually attempted. Exercise attribution, correction/deletion, uncertainty, multimodal cases and no-egress custody.
steps.gate: Independent assembled tests require zero critical authority/privacy failures on the qualified suite and causal specialist value against a real seeded-untrained control. A source-only language-head diagnostic cannot substitute for that matched comparison. Diagnosed failures trigger targeted repair and requalification; no finite test certifies universal zero foreign influence.

optional_diagnostics.operation: Inventory BF16 tensor names, shapes and offsets without assigning behavior to a tensor based on its name.
optional_diagnostics.gate: Source digest and config agree; the inventory is structural evidence only.

optional_diagnostics.operation: Emit the existing seven public synthetic inputs and freeze the emitted prompt bytes before model runs.
optional_diagnostics.gate: No private Elaina, Rayan or consumer payload; record prompt digest and fixture/source revisions. This diagnostic is not FINAL gold.

optional_diagnostics.operation: Optional public baseline inference against the unmodified source; capture deterministic outputs and runtime/device provenance if useful to diagnose an observed assembled MFM failure.
optional_diagnostics.gate: Real model outputs, runtime/device receipt and unexercised modality coverage are recorded. Never substitute a stub or the -it trainer.

optional_intervention.operation: Localize an observed unwanted behavior with a controlled intervention and independently produce an explicitly justified replacement tensor. The staging CLI streams exactly one named same-shape payload after checking old/new SHA-256 and size. It does not choose, generate, or validate the efficacy of that payload.
optional_intervention.implementation_status: Manifest-checked staging and sealed stage receipt implemented with tiny synthetic tests. No real replacement payload, 24 GB intervention, causal localization or behavior result exists.
optional_intervention.gate: The parent clone and payload are authenticated; capture the staging tool's candidate_weight_sha256 and old/new tensor hashes as a durable receipt. Candidate remains staged_unqualified. No candidate should be promoted on a tensor name, token marker, or speculative edit alone.
optional_intervention.when: Only a specific assembled MFM failure with causal evidence implicating source weights justifies this optional one-tensor route; other repairs may target specialist training or governed runtime instead.

optional_intervention.operation: Make a separately hash-linked MFM derivative from the staged candidate, verify changed weight bytes and publisher notices, and retain immutable parent and rollback. Bind the derivative's file digest to the captured staging output before asserting this was the one-tensor candidate. Derivative custody is not a behavior pass.
optional_intervention.implementation_status: Custody and integrity tooling has tiny synthetic tests only. No actual prepared Gemma derivative exists.
optional_intervention.gate: Fresh derivative receipt binds the stage receipt, operation digest, exact candidate weight hash and exclusive named-tensor diff. The artifact remains behaviorally unqualified until paired tests; receipt hashes are local integrity evidence, not signatures.

optional_intervention.operation: Run matched untouched and prepared-base diagnostics, independently check the targeted inherited behavior, general competence and cross-role regressions, and either retain or reject the candidate with a causal receipt.
optional_intervention.implementation_status: Prepared runner and seven-case scorer have CPU fixture tests. No real 12B paired inference or independent broad behavior qualification has run. The diagnostic alone cannot promote a base.
optional_intervention.gate: A changed hash is never suppression evidence. A matched causal and competence assessment must improve independent cases without unacceptable regression. If retained, repeat specialist training/preflight against the new prepared_base_dir/receipt and rerun qualification.

optional_intervention_reentry.condition: Only after independent paired causal/competence evidence supports a diagnosed base-weight repair.
optional_intervention_reentry.gate: Recompute processor/optimizer/checkpoint lineage from the selected derivative and rerun independent assembled qualification. An edit hash or seven-case diagnostic is not a capability pass.
